name: List schemas
desc: Named, typed metadata field sets for VOD assets.

name: Create schema
desc: Create a metadata schema. Fields: string|text|number|boolean|date|enum|url|tags.

name: List channels
desc: Channels for the tenant.

name: Get channel
desc: One channel + its inputs & instances.

name: Start channel
desc: Orchestrator launches the encoder task + opens a recording. The channel needs a primary source with an address or stream key, or the answer is 400 saying what to add.

name: Stop channel
desc: Terminates the task, closes the recording, fires the thumbnailer.

name: List events
desc: Events for the tenant.

name: Create event
desc: Schedule an event; the orchestrator provisions it at server_start.

name: List scheduled clips
desc: Clipping windows on the live timeline.

name: Schedule a clip
desc: When end_epoch_ms is reached the orchestrator cuts a VOD asset. outputKind: manifest|progressive|both.

name: Cancel scheduled clip
desc: Cancel while still scheduled.

name: Timeline grid (Past, Now, Next)
desc: Every visible stream on one clock: programmes (as-run preferred), recorded media and gaps, clips and five-gate status. Window defaults to two hours back and four ahead, capped at 48 hours; 50 rows a page with a cursor.

name: List recordings
desc: Filter by ?kind=channel_day|event & ?channelId=.

name: Channel roll-up
desc: Channels with recording counts + next expiry.

name: Get recording
desc: One recording + its derived VOD assets.

name: Clip a recording
desc: Create a VOD from a time range. outputKind sets HLS/DASH and/or progressive MP4. Answers 409 no_media, with the gaps, when nothing is recorded in the range (as in the capture, which has no media).

name: Download recording
desc: Presigned MP4 URL (202 while exporting). 409 no_media, with the gaps, when the range holds no recorded media (as in the capture).

name: List VOD
desc: Derived assets. ?published=true|false.

name: Get VOD (+ schema.org)
desc: Asset + assigned schema + publications + schema.org JSON-LD.

name: Update VOD metadata
desc: Set title/metadata (validated vs the assigned schema) & published.

name: schema.org VideoObject
desc: JSON-LD for the portal / SEO / social metadata.

name: List filler
desc: Uploaded slate/loop assets.

name: Register filler
desc: Register + get a presigned upload URL.

name: Delete filler
desc: Remove a filler asset.

name: Upload an image to the library
desc: Put an image in the account's library (store key library/{accountId}/posters/grand-final.png). The image service renders from here. 409 when it is already there.

name: Search the library (files and folders)
desc: One search box for the Image Library. Words match as prefixes against names, tags, keywords, titles, place names, programme and channel names, descriptions and cameras; folders whose path contains every word come back too. Same filters as GET /api/files: folder, recursive, kind, tag, source (upload | watchfolder | encoder | library), channel, from/to, hasLocation=1, near=lat,lng,km, sort, limit, offset. See docs/IMAGES.md section 17.

name: Folder children (lazy tree)
desc: Children of one folder ('' = top level) with count, total (everything below) and hasChildren. ?q=words finds folders anywhere.

name: Re-read an image's metadata
desc: Read EXIF / GPS / IPTC / XMP from the stored bytes again (taken_at, gps_lat/lng/alt, location, camera, title, description, keywords, creator, copyright, checksum, metadata).

name: Image service config
desc: Where signed URLs point (the image CDN in the cloud), the size and source limits, and the enabled output formats. See docs/IMAGES.md.

name: Account signing key
desc: This account's image signing key, for building URLs locally with the SDK (packages/image-url) as the console does. It signs only this account's images: the server derives it from the account id in the image path. Never cached (Cache-Control: private, no-store).

name: Sign image URL
desc: Options to one signed render URL. path is relative to the account's library (or a full library/{accountId}/... key). Options: width, height (0 = auto), fit (cover | inside | contain | fill; fit-in and stretch accepted), crop {x,y,w,h} %, focus {x,y} % or a gravity (center, top, ..., smart, entropy), grayscale, blur, brightness, saturation, sharpen, background, quality, format (webp | avif | jpeg | png), enlarge, version. The upload time is added as v= so a replaced image gets a fresh URL. The same guards as rendering apply (400 when outside them). URLs do not expire: expiresIn is accepted and ignored.

name: Sign several URLs
desc: Up to 100 items in one call; the answer keeps their order.

name: Render (signed)
desc: The public render URL: no session, the signature is the authorisation. First request renders (X-Image-Cache: MISS) and stores the derivative; repeats come from memory, the derivative cache, or the CDN. Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable.

name: Render without a signature (refused)
desc: The pre-production unsigned shape. Every render URL must be signed; there is no unsafe mode.

name: Thumbnail storyboard (hover previews)
desc: Sprite sheets of a channel or event for a wall-clock span (from/to epoch ms, at most 48 h; default the last hour): {tileW, tileH, intervalMs, units, sheets: [{url, startMs, endMs, cols, filled}]}. Tile i of a sheet is at x = (i % cols) * tileW, y = floor(i / cols) * tileH. prime=1 builds missing hours in the background. See docs/THUMBNAILS.md.

name: Thumbnail hours (status)
desc: Hours of thumbnails for a channel or event (default: the last 24 h): status (building | complete | empty), tiles, gaps, sheets, and the library folder thumbnails/<channel>/<date>/<hour>.

name: Clip thumbnail VTT
desc: WebVTT thumbnails for a clip: the channel's hourly cues for the clip's source ranges, re-timed to the clip, pointing at the existing sprite sheets. Also /api/thumbnails/recordings/{id}.vtt and /api/thumbnails/vtt?stream&from&to.

name: List publish targets
desc: Configured social accounts.

name: Link account
desc: platform: youtube|facebook|x|tiktok|dailymotion|portal.

name: Publish to portal
desc: Make portal-visible + create a publication record.

name: Publish to social
desc: Push to a linked social account (adapter). Tracks external id/url + views.

name: List publications
desc: Per-asset publications + synced view counts.

name: Sync view counts
desc: Pull latest view counts from platforms (adapter).

name: Encoder report (ingest)
desc: The encoder posts events + status snapshots (ingest-token auth).

name: All stream status
desc: Latest status per stream (dashboard poll).

name: Channel status
desc: One stream snapshot.

name: Channel events
desc: Per-stream event log.
